headline: Brazil Economic Team Considers Banco do Brasil Leadership Change
summary: Government officials in Brazil are evaluating a replacement for the chief executive officer of state-controlled Banco do Brasil after the bank's net profit fell 66.5 percent.
why: Banco do Brasil is one of South America's largest state-owned financial institutions and a primary lender to Brazil's agricultural sector. Governance changes at state entities directly impact investor sentiment.

impacts.name: Banco do Brasil
impacts.why: A 66.5% profit drop and executive replacement speculation pressure equity valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Speculation regarding executive changes following a steep profit decline weighed on Banco do Brasil equity shares.
